purpose: Prospective WELP methodology and historical compatibility policy; snapshot manifests remain immutable.
rules: Frozen historical snapshots, contracts, fixtures, scorers, and campaign bundles are immutable. Reproducing a historical campaign uses the frozen artifacts recorded in that snapshot.

New campaigns run under the current DRAFT snapshot. The 2026-09-19 methodology revision introduces outcome semantics (welp-outcomes 0.1.0-draft), the generation-budget policy (welp-generation-budget 0.1.0-draft), reliability scorer v2 + gate_v2 (welp-reliability 0.2.0-draft), and in-repo classification (welp-final-classification 0.2.0-draft).

Historical campaign results are never relabeled under the new outcome vocabulary. Scorer-only rescoring of retained raw outputs is new supplementary evidence, explicitly linked to the original event; it never rewrites result JSON, reports, or published verdicts.
A supplemental completion (e.g. a bounded retest under the revised methodology) is a NEW event linked to the original campaign/evidence, following the append-only precedent.

Validator R09-R14 apply from 2026-09-19. R15-R16 apply from 2026-09-23 only. An older fixture/scorer hash differing from current source is compared with its frozen snapshot manifest, not invalidated because the canonical source advanced.

No cross-methodology score equivalence is claimed between v1 boolean outcomes, 2026-09-19 CP-1 triples, and prospective calibrated semantic/deployment prompt lanes. Each comparison must retain prompt/profile/budget/fixture identities.

2026-09-23 supersedes word-fraction Family A construction with final-rendered-token placement; retains the five facts, depths and ±0.50 pp threshold. Earlier 8K/16K placement failures are fixture-limited historical evidence, not model retrieval failures. New lane-specific context reserves supersede a universal 512-token semantic reserve; 512 remains historical or a real declared operational cap.

Prompt lanes MINIMAL, DEPLOYMENT, PUBLISHER when material, OPTIMIZED when preregistered are prospective. Historical prompts cannot be retroactively attributed to a new lane without exact byte/config evidence. Classification profile identity is required prospectively; blocked methodology execution does not imply an integration-blocked model.

Blocked LFM2.5-8B-A1B evidence and its BOS-invalidated attempt remain untouched: C0/artifact/runtime identity and measured fit/performance may be cited if unchanged and verified; reliability under arbitrary historical ceilings and context Family A 1.1 scores are not equivalent to prospective lanes/placement. Repeat reliability semantic/operational lanes and useful-context rungs under the new frozen method in a NEW linked campaign; recheck admission/profile, do not promote 2048 diagnostic outputs or reasoning traces to a verdict.

Unchanged: exact artifact/hardware/runtime provenance, CP-1 outcome axes, evidence classes, early host-safety stops, execution state distinct from verdict, append-only evidence, public central registry authority and clean-success automatic lifecycle closeout.
